name: United Renewable Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: United Renewable Energy Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sale of photovoltaic cells, modules, and silicon wafers. Its global reach includes key markets such as Taiwan, India, Germany, and the United States. The company organizes its operations across several divisions: Solar Cells, Modules, Power Facilities, and other business activities. Its product lineup features both mono-crystalline and bifacial solar cells, as well as various solar modules. URE also provides comprehensive management services for solar operations. Beyond manufacturing, URE actively engages in the full lifecycle of solar energy system projects, from development and construction to financing and eventual sale. The company's diverse interests also extend to general construction, the production and distribution of electronic components, initiatives combining solar technology with agriculture, and providing technical management services. Originally incorporated in 2005 as Neo Solar Power Corp., United Renewable Energy Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.
